title: Multilingual Political Views of Large Language Models: Identification and Steering
findings: The paper does not report specific findings related to the religion domain. The results from the religion-related questions were aggregated with other domains to calculate the overall social (libertarian-authoritarian) and economic (left-right) political compass scores. The main findings focus on these aggregated scores, such as larger models shifting toward libertarian-left positions.
